name: Build the Pyramid!
summary: All working Build the Pyramid! codes for free coins and boosts, checked in-game, plus where to find the code box.
about:
Build the Pyramid! is a Roblox building game by Janitors Studios. You haul blocks across the desert and stack them up into a pyramid, earning coins as you go.

Coins go back into upgrades: more walk speed to make each run faster, and more carry capacity so you can move bigger loads at once. Codes give you a head start on both.

codes.reward: Limited to the first 2,000 players to redeem it
Limited to the first 1,000 players to redeem it

redeemSteps: Look at the row of icons in the top-left corner of the screen.
Click the gear icon to open the menu shown below.
Pick Codes, then click the "ENTER CODE" box.
Type or paste a code and press Redeem.

redeemImage.alt: Build the Pyramid gear icon in the top-left menu bar, and the Codes window with the Enter Code box and Redeem button

troubleshooting.a: Codes are usually case-sensitive, so use the Copy button instead of typing them out.
Each code works once per account.
Some codes only work for the first few thousand players, so they run out rather than expire.
The code has probably expired. Check back after the next update.
